sign_convention: separation = V(rbl|stored0) - V(rbl|stored1) at t_sense (column-wide worst case over all 4 selected rows x 8 other-row patterns); positive = '1' discharged rbl further

criteria_ASSUMPTIONS.latency: every stored-1 point reaches the 0.1 V droop no later than t_sense

baseline.why: Phase 2 deck re-rendered by the variant harness; must equal the committed run

attr_force_sn1_0p8.why: write bypassed, stored '1' initialised to 0.8 V (read-path transfer)

attr_force_sn1_0p9.why: write bypassed, stored '1' initialised to 0.9 V (read-path transfer)

attr_force_sn1_1p0.why: write bypassed, stored '1' initialised to 1.0 V (read-path transfer)

attr_force_sn1_1p1.why: write bypassed, stored '1' initialised to 1.1 V (read-path transfer)

attr_force_sn1_1p2.why: write bypassed, stored '1' initialised to 1.2 V (read-path transfer)

attr_force_sn1_1p4.why: write bypassed, stored '1' initialised to 1.4 V (read-path transfer)

attr_force_sn1_1p8.why: write bypassed, stored '1' initialised to 1.8 V (read-path transfer)

nc_write_disabled.why: write wordline never rises, so every cell keeps the INVERSE of its data; signed separation must be negative and the point must FAIL

rem_vwl_2p0.why: write wordline boosted to 2.0 V (needs a boosted WL supply; 1.8 V device overdriven)

rem_rwl_m0p2.why: selected read wordline driven to -0.2 V (needs a negative read-WL supply)

rem_wr_lvt.why: M_WR low-Vt flavour (raises written level; costs storage-node leakage)

rem_rd_lvt.why: M_RD low-Vt flavour (raises read current; fresh-only screen)
